en: A colorized historical military scene showing several cavalry soldiers in light blue uniforms with white trim and tall black boots, wearing yellow pickelhaube-style helmets. They stand in a line in front of their horses, some holding lances with pennants, others reading from a map or document. The background shows a stand of birch trees under a blue sky. Red German text is printed at the top.
